profileLabel: Center-left economics; liberal social values (medium confidence)
summary: Cavite 7th District representative with 122 principal-authored bills. Authored recognition of civil solidarity pacts of couples, expanded grounds for legal separation, Safe Spaces Act amendments, free annual check-ups, a cancer center, dialysis wards, protection for BPO workers, workers' right to self-organization, higher public education salaries, senior utility discounts and a right-to-information bill.
caveat: Right to information is a single institutions issue and unscored. Bill-based evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free annual check-ups, a cancer center and dialysis wards (-3), workers' right to self-organization and BPO protections (-2 to -3), higher teacher salaries (-2) and senior utility discounts (-2), against pro bono physician tax incentives and travel-tax abolition (+1).
